

class ValContractMemoryRewardTests(unittest.TestCase):
    @classmethod
    def setUpClass(cls):
        from tools.validators.validate_adiscord_division_templates import parse_clausewitz
        cls.parse = staticmethod(parse_clausewitz)
        cls.focus_tree = cls.one(parse_clausewitz(FOCUSES_PATH.read_text(encoding="utf-8")), "focus_tree")
        cls.decisions = parse_clausewitz(DECISIONS_PATH.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        cls.campaigns = cls.one(cls.decisions, "VAL_contract_management")
        cls.categories = parse_clausewitz((ROOT / "common/decisions/categories/ADISCORD_VAL_rework_categories.txt").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        cls.shared = parse_clausewitz((ROOT / "common/scripted_effects/ADISCORD_shared_action_effects.txt").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        cls.general = ("VAL_campaign_rifles_and_bread", "VAL_campaign_contracts_feed_families", "VAL_campaign_no_promise_without_payment")

    @staticmethod
    def values(entries, key):
        return [entry.value for entry in entries if entry.key == key]

    @classmethod
    def one(cls, entries, key):
        values = cls.values(entries, key)
        if len(values) != 1:
            raise AssertionError(f"Expected one {key}, found {len(values)}")
        return values[0]

    def reward(self, focus_id):
        focus = next(entry.value for entry in self.focus_tree if entry.key == "focus" and self.values(entry.value, "id") == [focus_id])
        return self.one(focus, "completion_reward")

    def test_ministry_funds_one_campaign_with_a_visible_reward(self):
        reward = self.reward("VAL_Ministry_Of_Contract_Memory")
        self.assertEqual(self.values(reward, "add_political_power"), ["50"])
        for decision in self.general:
            self.assertLessEqual(float(self.one(self.one(self.campaigns, decision), "cost")), 50)

    def test_ministry_names_the_three_immediate_campaign_unlocks(self):
        reward = self.reward("VAL_Ministry_Of_Contract_Memory")
        self.assertEqual(set(self.values(reward, "unlock_decision_tooltip")), set(self.general))

    def test_both_slot_focuses_show_capacity_and_hide_bookkeeping(self):
        for focus_id, flag in (("VAL_Ministry_Of_Contract_Memory", "VAL_propaganda_slot_granted"), ("VAL_Two_Concurrent_Narratives", "VAL_second_propaganda_slot_granted")):
            with self.subTest(focus=focus_id):
                reward = self.reward(focus_id)
                self.assertIn("VAL_campaign_slot_granted_tt", self.values(reward, "custom_effect_tooltip"))
                hidden = self.one(reward, "hidden_effect")
                guard = self.one(hidden, "if")
                self.assertEqual(self.one(self.one(self.one(guard, "limit"), "NOT"), "has_country_flag"), flag)
                self.assertEqual(self.values(guard, "ADISCORD_campaign_slot_grant"), ["yes"])
                self.assertEqual(self.values(guard, "set_country_flag"), [flag])
                self.assertEqual(self.values(reward, "set_country_flag"), [])

    def test_quarterly_route_does_not_unlock_ministry_campaigns(self):
        for decision in self.general:
            with self.subTest(decision=decision):
                visible = self.one(self.one(self.campaigns, decision), "visible")
                self.assertEqual(self.values(visible, "has_completed_focus"), ["VAL_Ministry_Of_Contract_Memory"])
                self.assertEqual(self.values(visible, "OR"), [])

    def test_mine_campaign_requires_ministry_and_actual_metal_loss(self):
        visible = self.one(self.one(self.campaigns, "VAL_campaign_the_mine_was_stolen"), "visible")
        self.assertEqual(self.values(visible, "has_completed_focus"), ["VAL_Ministry_Of_Contract_Memory"])
        self.assertEqual(self.values(visible, "has_country_flag"), ["VAL_westerholm_metal_lost"])

    def test_campaigns_release_the_same_slot_and_keep_shortages_visible(self):
        for decision in (*self.general, "VAL_campaign_the_mine_was_stolen"):
            with self.subTest(decision=decision):
                entry = self.one(self.campaigns, decision)
                self.assertEqual(self.values(self.one(entry, "available"), "ADISCORD_has_campaign_slot"), ["yes"])
                self.assertEqual(self.values(self.one(entry, "complete_effect"), "ADISCORD_campaign_slot_consume"), ["yes"])
                self.assertEqual(self.values(self.one(entry, "remove_effect"), "ADISCORD_campaign_slot_release"), ["yes"])
        for effect in ("ADISCORD_campaign_slot_grant", "ADISCORD_campaign_slot_release"):
            delta = self.one(self.one(self.shared, effect), "add_to_variable")
            self.assertEqual(self.one(delta, "var"), "ADISCORD_available_campaign_slots")
            self.assertEqual(self.one(delta, "value"), "1")
        consume = self.one(self.one(self.shared, "ADISCORD_campaign_slot_consume"), "if")
        self.assertEqual(self.one(self.one(consume, "limit"), "ADISCORD_has_campaign_slot"), "yes")
        delta = self.one(consume, "add_to_variable")
        self.assertEqual(self.one(delta, "var"), "ADISCORD_available_campaign_slots")
        self.assertEqual(self.one(delta, "value"), "-1")

    def test_combined_category_preserves_quarterly_contracts(self):
        visible = self.one(self.one(self.categories, "VAL_contract_management"), "visible")
        self.assertEqual(set(self.values(self.one(visible, "OR"), "has_completed_focus")), {"VAL_Ministry_Of_Contract_Memory", "VAL_Quarterly_Contract_Norm"})
        for decision in ("VAL_quarterly_contract_deadline", "VAL_pay_quarterly_contract_norm"):
            self.one(self.campaigns, decision)
        for path in (FOCUSES_PATH, DECISIONS_PATH, ROOT / "common/decisions/categories/ADISCORD_VAL_rework_categories.txt"):
            self.assertIsNone(re.search(r"(?m)^(?:<{7}|={7}|>{7})(?: |$)", path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")))

    def test_campaign_capacity_and_funding_are_localised_in_both_languages(self):
        for language in ("russian", "english"):
            with self.subTest(language=language):
                path = ROOT / f"localisation/{language}/ADISCORD_VAL_decisions_l_{language}.yml"
                raw = path.read_bytes()
                self.assertTrue(raw.startswith(b"\xef\xbb\xbf"))
                text = raw.decode("utf-8-sig")
                for key in ("VAL_campaign_slot_granted_tt", "VAL_Ministry_Of_Contract_Memory_desc", "VAL_contract_management_desc"):
                    entries = re.findall(rf'^\s*{key}:\d*\s*"([^\n]*)"\s*$', text, re.MULTILINE)
                    self.assertEqual(len(entries), 1, key)
                    if key.endswith("Memory_desc"):
                        self.assertIn("50", entries[0])
                    if key == "VAL_contract_management_desc":
                        self.assertIn("[?ADISCORD_available_campaign_slots|0]", entries[0])
